245)༄༅/rtsa gsum spyi yi me mchod las bzhi'i bang mdzod bzhugs so/oṃ swa sti/'dir tshogs gnyis spel ba dang nyams chag dag par bya ba gtsor gyur la phrin

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ rtsa gsum spyi yi me mchod las bzhi'i bang mdzod bzhugs so/ oṃ swa sti/ 'dir tshogs gnyis spel ba dang nyams chag dag par bya ba gtsor gyur la phrin las gzhan pa'i kha sgyur kyang bgyi bar rung*/ me mchod bya bar 'dod na/ dngos rdzas bsog pa ni/ mar khu/ yam shing*/ til dkar/ dkar gsum mngar gsum dang dri bzang gis sbags pa'i zho zan/ so ba/ 'bras/ nas/ bro/ sran ma/ yungs dkar/ ku sha/ durba/ shing tog dar sna/ sman sna/ rin po che'i rigs dang*/ las mdog dang mthun pa'i me dar rnams kyang bsag gnyis pa thab bca' ba ni/ bdag gi rnal 'byor dang ldan pas bdud rtsi 'khyil pa'i sngags kyis bsang chu bsgrub/ gang du bya ba'i gzhi ma dul ba yin na sa chog bya/ de nas rlan can gyis sa steng 'jam/ po la/ rdul tshon gyis 'od phreng dang*/ rdo ra zlum por bskor ba'i dbus su gdan dang*/ lha mtshan mngon rtogs ltar dgaud/ de'i steng lha rdzas las rung ba'am bud shing bzang po ran par brtsig nye logs ci bde bar mchod gtor bzang po dang tshogs 'khor/ sreg rdzas rnams kyang 'du bya'o/ gsum pa dngos gzhi'i rim pa ni/ bsang chu 'thor zhing*/ a mṛ ta sa bsang*/ stong pa'i ngang las mchod rdzas dang sreg rdzas rnams rang rang gi ming yig dang po thig les brgyan pa las byung ba'i bdud rtsi'i dngos po las thams cad la thogs pa med par bskul zhing lha tshogs rnams dgyes pa skong ba'i nus ldan du gyur/ nang mchod 'thor zhing*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥ 246) lan bdun brjod/ las mthun gyi me sbar la/ āḥ chos rnams rang bzhin skye ba med: nam mkha' dbyings kyi dbang phyug ma'i: klong na las bzhi rdzogs pa'i thabs: spyan dang mā ki'i mkha' dbyings su: zhal phyag yangs pa'i me lha ni: yum chen na bza' dkar mo nyid: dam tshig sgrol ma'i brtul zhugs dang: mnyam sbyor byin za 'bar ba'i klong: las gzhung gang yin gyi lha bskyed/ spyan 'dren/ mchod gtor rnams byas nas dang pa blug bzung la/

hūm̐: dgang blug dkyil 'khor ma lus pa'i: zhal gyi ngo bo rnam dag cing: rdo rje'i ljags steng hūm̐ḥyig gis: sreg rdzas bdud rtsi'i rgyun drangs nas: zag med bde bas rab tu mnyes: las mthun 'od zer 'phros pa yis: mchod thun dngos grub thob par 'gyur: ces brjod cing bsam la/ rtsa sngags gsham/ sarba pāṃ paṃ shān+tiṃ ku ru swa hāḥ zhes bdun gyis mar khu dbul/ rnal 'byor pa bdag dang yon gyi bdag po'i nad gdon sdig sgrib 'gal rkyen bar gcod gsang sngags kyi cho ga'i lhag chad dam tshig nyams chag nyes ltung ma dang mkha' 'gro'i bka' chad thams cad shān+tiṃ ku ru swa hāḥ zhes 'dod don gsol/ de nas yam shing 'bul/ de rjes rdzas gzhan rnams kyang gcig tu bsdoms te 'bul tshul de dang 'dra/ zhi byed dmigs bsal yod na/ rtsa sngags gsham bur/ sarba pa pāṃ gya ི mal du/ dam tshig nyams chags thams cad shān+tiṃ ku ru swa hā: 247) de bzhin du rgyas pa la/ tshe dang bsod nams puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru hoḥ dbang la/ khams gsum skye dgu'i bla yid wā' shaṃ ku ru hoḥ mngon spyod/ dgra bgegs 'byung po mā ra ya phāṭaḥ zhes bsgyur/ rdzas la mtshon na/ zhib la mar khu dang*/ til dkar nag pad kha rnams bung bskyed/ rgyas pa la/ zho zan dang*/ dūrba rin chen dang shing tog rnams/ dbang la ro mngar zhing snum pa'i bza' bca' dang*/ me tog dang*/ 'bru dmar po'i rigs/ dgra bgaigs zhi ba la/ yungs kar dang gu gul tsha ba gsum dang lan tsha'i khus cung zad sbags pa zhi ba'i mthu dang ldan pa'i mngon spyod mdzad do/ tshul de bzhin du mchod rdzas dang sreg rdzas thab dkyil la sogs pa'i kha dog las mthun dang*/ gtso bo ting nge 'dzin gyis gri kha'i rno la ngar gyis gdab pa bzhin no/ rdzas rnams rdzogs pa dang*/ oṃ badz+ra was+t+ra ye swa hāḥ gos zung dang*/ badz+ra taṃ bu la ye swa hā: zhes so rtsi 'bul/ tshogs kyi 'khor los mchod/ dngos grub blangs ba'i rjes thog tu/

byon skyems 'bul la/ oṃ: khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzad: sogs kyi mthar/ badz+ra muḥ sa/ ye shes pa gshegs: dam tshig pa rang la 'dres par bsam/ de nas bsngo ba/ smon lam/ shis pa brjod pa spyi dang mthun par bya'o/ me ni dkyil 'khor lha yi zhal: mngon sum nyid du longs spyod pas: bsod nams nang nas sbyin sreg mchog: rno la myur ba'i las brtsams na: rnal 'byor ldan pas 'di la 'bad: sa ma yā: rgya rgya rgya: rje dpal lding pas gsol 248)ba nan gyis btab pas lo phyi ma la rgya khrol: zhes rig 'dzin yum ka'i me mchod lhag pa'i lha spyi la sbyar rung ba'i ched du pad+ma ma ṇis bris pa dge legs 'phel/ zhi bar/ bdag cag slob dpon 'khor dang bcas pa'i nad gdon sdig sgrib bar chad mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad shān+tiṃ ku ru swa hā: rgyas par/ bdag cag= tshe dang bsod nams ye shes thams cad puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru oṃ: dbang la/ bdag cag= khams gsum skye rgu'i dpal 'byor thams cad wa shaṃ ku ru ho: drag por/ bdag cag 'khor bcas pa la gnod cing 'tshe ba'i dgra bgegs gdug pa can thams cad mā ra ya phaṭa: ༈ dgang blug la/ sngags la 'dod gsol rol gcig yam shing sngags brgya/ 'dod gsol rol gcig mar khu sngags brgya/ 'dod gsol rol gcig rdzas sder brgyad la sngags brgya re/ 'dod gsol rol re re/ yam shing*/ mar khu/ rdzas sder brgyad tsho bcu rdzogs nas// dge'o//
